Quad - [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px]]5,800 (Hard) |shield_hp = [[File:ShieldHealth.png|20px|Shield Health]]25 |defense = {{Defense}}20% |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Below Average (2.7) |cash = {{Money|1,250}} every 25% health |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Tank}} (''Fat Armor'') |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Fat Armor}}''' - Has [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] which is lost upon losing all of its [[Shield Health]]. }} ==Description== The '''Ducky Unit''' was an enemy that appeared in [[Bathroom Approach]] as part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] and its rerun in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. It has a very high amount of health, low [[Defense]] and below average speed. When it initially spawns in, it is [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] enemy thanks to its ''Fat Armor'' ability. Once it loses all of its [[Shield Health]], it will lose [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]]. ==Logbook Description== "''Ducky unit is a dedicated foot soldier of Mega Ducky. He is skilled in wing-to-wing combat and is a fearless addition to the Duck Army. Ducky Unit admires Super Soldier Duck and wants to be his friend, but Super Soldier Duck told him to go kick rocks.''" ==Appearance== The '''Ducky Unit''' is a very large yellow duck with black eyes, an orange beak and flippers. It wears a military protective hat on its head. It has three animations that it can randomly have, where all three also have differently shaped eyes. The first animation has it have a happy expression, the second has it have a serious expression while the third one has its eyes closed, likely because it is scared. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Bathroom Approach]] is listed instead. *Initially, fast firing towers like the [[Pursuit]], [[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Golden Minigunner]] or [[Turret]] are recommended as the '''Ducky Unit''' starts out as a [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] enemy. **Units can also be useful as their collisions bypass [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]]. **Once it has received 25 hits or a [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] bypassing form of damage depleted its [[Shield Health]] entirely, any tower can be used as it will not have [[Tank (Attribute)|Tank]] by then. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1DuckyUnit1.png|Green variant, current version, first animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1DuckyUnit2.png|Green variant, current version, second animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) DefHacker1DuckyUnit3.png|Green variant, current version, third animation variant (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseDuckyUnit.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} DuckHunt2025PI2.png|'''Ducky Unit''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Ducky Battlepass -
